messages:
claire: Heads-up: PR #1302 changed the Console "structured output" examples to use a new top-level key `structured_output_schema_v2` (object with `fields`) instead of the old `response_schema`. The static snippet generator failed to render several Node/Python examples and the quickstart validation now errors.

hiro: saw the CI alerts. Can you confirm which pages and example files are affected?

claire: Affected files I found: docs/console/observability/structured_outputs.md, examples/structured/output_examples.json, examples/node/structured_response.js, examples/python/structured_response.py. The example validator throws: "unknown property: response_schema".

ben: why did the key change? was this part of the schema hardening effort?

claire: yep. The schema team tightened the format to encourage explicit field typing (name, type, description). `response_schema` was ambiguous: it allowed free-form JSON schema. v2 uses a compact list-of-fields form we can validate on the server. The backend started enforcing v2 before docs/snippets were updated.

samira: short term we should: 1) patch the docs/examples to use v2 format, 2) add a migration paragraph showing automatic conversion from the old free-form JSON schema to the v2 field list, and 3) add a small compatibility shim in the snippet generator that accepts `response_schema` and converts to v2 during generation for 2 releases.

hiro: i can add the generator shim. it will: detect `response_schema`, call the converter, and emit a warning comment in generated snippets. i'll add tests.

ben: docs need a clear migration example. can you draft a before/after and a tiny Python converter to include in the examples folder?

claire: draft migration blurb below (PTAL):

```
# old (deprecated)
"response_schema": {
  "title": "order",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {"id": {"type": "string"}, "total": {"type": "number"}}
}

# new (structured_output_schema_v2)
"structured_output_schema_v2": {
  "fields": [
    {"name": "id", "type": "string", "description": "order id"},
    {"name": "total", "type": "number", "description": "order total in USD"}
  ]
}
```

claire: converter (python) to include in examples/tools/convert_schema.py:
```
import json,sys
old = json.load(sys.stdin)
props = old.get('response_schema', {}).get('properties', {})
fields = []
for n,spec in props.items():
  fields.append({'name': n, 'type': spec.get('type','string'), 'description': spec.get('description','')})
print(json.dumps({'structured_output_schema_v2': {'fields': fields}}, indent=2))
```

hiro: perfect. i'll wire the shim to call that converter automatically during snippet generation and add the deprecation TODO with a date.

samira: i'll open the docs PR to update the pages and add the migration section and the converter example. I'll also add a short note in structured_outputs.md about the rationale and a compatibility table. Requesting claire for review.

docs-ci: docs CI: example generation failed for examples/node/structured_response.js (unknown key: response_schema). See https://ci.redwood/inference/1302/build/7

hiro: shim PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-tools/pull/77  adds converter call in snippet generator + tests.

samira: docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310  updates examples, adds migration blurb and converter script in examples/tools. Marked for claire review. CI currently rerunning.

ben: plan: merge generator shim first to keep CI green, then merge docs PR and regenerate snippets. After two releases we'll remove the shim and update the migration note to say the old key is no longer accepted. Also add a docs CI linter that flags `response_schema` in examples so future PRs don't reintroduce it.

hiro: agreed. i'll include a lint rule in the snippet generator repo and the docs CI job to fail if `response_schema` appears in committed examples (until we remove the alias).

claire: assigned: samira -> docs PR (migration blurb + converter), hiro -> snippet generator shim + lint, ben -> release note blurb and timeline, claire -> final docs sign-off and canary QA. Once merged, we'll run the playground canary for 45 minutes and watch for parsing errors.

samira: merging once CI is green. thanks all. :thumbsup:
